rubric.note: This rubric is illustrative for a small evaluation set. It is NOT a scientific benchmark. Results in mock mode validate structural behavior, not answer quality.

dimensions.name: evidence_relevance
dimensions.description: Cited sources are topically relevant to the query

dimensions.name: citation_traceability
dimensions.description: Every finding cites at least one source ID that exists in answer.sources

dimensions.name: answer_coverage
dimensions.description: Short answer addresses the main intent of the query

dimensions.name: uncertainty_honesty
dimensions.description: Confidence score and rationale honestly reflect evidence completeness

dimensions.name: failure_robustness
dimensions.description: Zero-evidence case returns structured refusal, not fabrication

dimensions.name: output_schema_validity
dimensions.description: StructuredAnswer passes Pydantic validation without errors

rubric.scoring_note: Scores are assigned only to evidence actually observed in test runs, not theoretical capability.
